bait_content.title: Simulated: Cache Sync Required
bait_content.body: This is a controlled test notification for security evaluation. It mimics a cache coherency event where write‑back buffers exceeded the threshold and a sync was deferred. No system changes will occur—use this to validate how the UI handles system‑style alerts.
